evidence_boundary: This per-task spec defines execution contracts only. It does not contain task outputs, scores, or downstream success evidence.

input_contract.original_style_input: A small Kaggle-style tabular dataset, objective metric, train/validation split, starter workspace, and submission contract.

output_contract.required_output: A runnable solution script plus submission file and run log.

metric_contract.name: validation_score
metric_contract.success_criterion: PaperToSkill condition produces a valid submission and improves over the starting baseline under the same budget.
metric_contract.source_metric_relation: Matches AIDE-style ML engineering optimization but may be a smaller local task.
metric_contract.metric_source_policy: Use the original task metric family where practical; document any local proxy.

reference_score_policy.label: AIDE reported Weco-Kaggle or MLE-Bench reference
reference_score_policy.policy: Treat original paper scores as reported references unless the same dataset, input/output, metric, model/tool budget, and runtime setting are reproduced locally.

run_controls.random_seed_policy: record seed when the task harness uses randomness

workflow_checklist: Maintain a solution tree or equivalent candidate history.
Evaluate each candidate with the declared objective metric.
Use feedback from failed or weaker candidates before refining.
Select the best solution based on measured score, not narrative confidence.
unsupported_error_policy: Count invented method claims that are not supported by the source paper or task fixture.
Count steps that contradict the declared input, output, metric, or run budget.
Count claims of completed results that are not present in the raw output log.
next_action: Create or select the fixture manifest and implement runner/scorer support before execution.
